# Harrison

[Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea)

## Overview

- **Age:** middle-aged  <sub>[v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P7](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0007)</sub>
- **Origin:** Scottsford, New Brunswick  <sub>[v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P57](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0057)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Titles:** Mr.  <sub>[v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P3](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0003)</sub>

## Appearance

Mr. Harrison is described as a short, fat, and bald man who is not considered handsome. Despite this, he maintains a neat and snug appearance.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P11](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0011), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P8](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0008)_

## Personality

Harrison is a middle-aged, fidgety, and fussy man who has a reputation for being odd and a crank. Outspoken and prideful in his frankness, he can also be outwardly sympathetic, kind, and nice, with a visible change in his demeanor noted after he remarries. He is known to smoke a pipe on his veranda and historically harbored a prejudice against marriage.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005), [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P39](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0039), [v2 IV Different Opinions P28](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0028), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P56](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0056), [v2 IX A Question of Color P40](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0040), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P7](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0007), +4 more_

## History

After living in Scottsford, [New Brunswick](../codex/places.md#new-brunswick), Harrison moved to Prince [Edward Island](../codex/places.md#edward-island), a place he had liked as a boy. Having kept bachelor's hall following his sister's death, he fulfilled a dying promise to her by marrying [Emily](../character/emily.md) Scott, though they subsequently separated over household disagreements and his parrot, [Ginger](../character/ginger.md). Upon settling as a new neighbor in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), Harrison angrily confronted [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) when a cow broke into his oat field. Shortly thereafter, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally sold Harrison's own Jersey cow by mistake; after she confessed and paid him back, the two shared tea and formed an unexpected friendship. Though he often voiced skepticism about her ideas and refused to donate to her hall improvement project, they remained close confidants, and Harrison eventually recounted the full history of his estranged marriage to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) before his wife, [Emily](../character/emily.md), unexpectedly reunited with him.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P1](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0001), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P4](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0004), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P15](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0015), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P38](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0038), [v2 II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure P12](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0012), [v2 II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure P24](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0024), +15 more_

> — Harrison — [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P27](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0027)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--harrison.md)

Harrison and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) first met on poor terms when he angrily confronted her after her cow broke into his oat field. Their relationship took a turn after [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally sold Harrison's stray cow to a neighbor, but her honest confession, complete with tea and cake, earned his mild reaction and launched an unexpected friendship. Though Harrison frequently challenges her ideas—such as doubting her gentle teaching methods and refusing to donate to her village improvement project—the neighbors regularly visit and confide in one another.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P1](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0001), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P4](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0004), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P15](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0015), +25 more_

- Friend of — neighbors and friends who confide in each other  <sub>[v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P39](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0039), [v2 IV Different Opinions P28](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0028), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P31](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0031), +1 more</sub>
